scope.mode: Independent focused review of the new source register, persisted dataset inventory and exported existing publicId helper. No useful historical diff exists for these local additions.
scope.ownership: Only this review report is written; canonical source and data remain untouched.

resolvedFindings.issue: Raw IDs alone did not expose the actual public food/section IDs. The initial artifact contained517published records whose raw IDs differed from app IDs.
resolvedFindings.fix: Emit publicFoodId/publicSectionId for published rows and null for nonpublished rows.
resolvedFindings.verification: Synthetic raw hashed ID emits the exact publicId result while preserving raw foodId. Real --check passes.

resolvedFindings.issue: The register omitted the boolean menu.held state used by the publication compiler. Existing boolean-held menus had other flags that happened to keep their15rows held.
resolvedFindings.verification: A menu held solely by this boolean now emits held, with no public IDs.

resolvedFindings.issue: Different raw IDs could normalize to one public key; an earlier held row could consume the published mapping and pass final leftover/total checks, incorrectly attributing the app food.
resolvedFindings.fix: Reject normalized menu-ID and normalized dataset/menu/food-key collisions before accepting a register.
resolvedFindings.verification: Synthetic raw/hashing-namespace food collision and menu collision both reject. Initial actual inventory had no normalized collisions.

resolvedFindings.issue: A nonempty invalid checkedAt/retrievedAt value was accepted as dated evidence.
resolvedFindings.fix: Validate both authored check/retrieval strings before choosing their explicit date basis; keep missing dates undated.
resolvedFindings.verification: Invalid checkedAt,invalid retrievedAt and invalid retrievedAt alongside a valid checkedAt all reject. Missing dates remain null/undated; retrievedAt fallback remains labeled.

checks.name: Generated register consistency
checks.assessment: Check recomputes the register, resolves every referenced source and actual published row, compares raw food totals against the inventory and compares saved output while ignoring generatedAt only.

checks.name: Food versus menu and branch evidence
assertions: Exact item evidence remains sourceBasis item
Menu and branch sourceRefs are separately recorded as context
A menu context check date using retrievedAt retains that basis
A branch context with no authored date stays explicitly undated
Menu-only and branch-only fallbacks retain their weaker sourceBasis

checks.name: Source resolution and collision safety
assertions: Pilot fallback records the pilot dataset rather than the referring research dataset

checks.name: Publication IDs and held state
assertions: Hashed publicFoodId matches existing publicId behavior
publicSectionId matches actual published section ID
Nonpublished records expose no public IDs

checks.name: Inventory dataset persistence
checks.assessment: Dataset count/list are derived from the same collected packet list. Existing collection path/visited guards and raw-food totals remain unchanged. Stdout omits the long list; persisted JSON retains it for exact register traversal.

checks.name: Provenance language and data boundary
checks.assessment: Register labels source observations and unconfirmed/historical pricing without certifying ingredients,live stock or future prices. Branch/whole-venue context remains separate from item proof. These are local research artifacts; this change introduces no app/API response payload.

limitations: Source linkage and regeneration checks do not independently certify merchant claims or verify transcription accuracy.
Initial collision/date audit found none in the then-current inventory; synthetic tests establish rejection safeguards.
No new test files,canonical edits,Google calls or other outbound requests were made.
Data is being integrated concurrently; counts and code hashes describe this captured review revision.
TypeScript,lint and native/app acceptance belong to the separate final gates.
